requirements.text: Possess a minimum of 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep experience building and operating production software systems, backend services, or distributed systems at scale.
Are highly proficient in at least one general-purpose programming language such as Go, Java, Python, Rust, or C++, with strong computer science fundamentals.
Have strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, storage systems, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture.
Have designed systems with rigorous correctness, reliability, observability, security, privacy, or access-control requirements.
Can collaborate with cross-functional partners to identify needs, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress from problem definition through delivery.
Bring a product-oriented mindset and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, translating customer and business problems into simple, scalable system designs.

Command strong sense of engineering excellence, contribute to a design-before-implementation approach with clear documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams to elevate the broader engineering organization.
Monetization or finance domain experience is helpful but not required. We value strong software engineering judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to learn a complex domain quickly.
Familiarity with financial correctness, reconciliation, compliance, or audit requirements.
Experience with high-scale distributed systems, transactional workflows, event streaming, or payment infrastructure.
Experience building internal platforms, shared frameworks, APIs, or developer tooling used by other engineering teams.
